subject: POC runway top-up vs runtime-credit swap — Velocity AI
messages:
From: Arjun Rao <arjun@velocityai.com>
To: david_kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@velocityai.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — convert remaining POC days to runtime credits?

Hi David,

Thanks again for the run so far — the team has been validating latency and cost numbers. We had a few unexpected delays with the integration and will likely miss a couple of the remaining test milestones.

Before we ask for a formal extension, wanted to check whether Redwood would consider converting the ~10 remaining evaluation days into an equivalent pool of "runtime credits" we can consume over the next 30 days. That would let us finish performance sweeps without extending the POC end date.

If that’s not doable, a 7–14 day runway extension would work too — we’re flexible, just hoping to avoid a full contract amendment.

Happy to share a quick usage snapshot if that helps.

Thanks,
Arjun
VP Product, Velocity AI

From: david.kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun@velocityai.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@velocityai.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — convert remaining POC days to runtime credits?

Arjun — thanks for the note and totally understand the situation. We can do this two ways and I’ve outlined options below so you can pick the one that maps best to your engineering schedule. I attached a short SOW-style sketch and a usage snapshot request form.

Options (approximate):
- Runtime-credit swap (recommended): convert remaining 10 calendar POC days into a pool of 20,000 runtime credits (equivalent to ~24h of dedicated burst GPU time under your current profile). Credits are usable for 30 days, non-refillable.
- Short runway extension: add 7 calendar days to the POC end date with no price change.
- Hybrid: 10k credits + 3-day extension.

For discounts / pricing: we can offer a one-time 10% concessional rate on incremental credits if Velocity converts to a short 3-month committed trial package thereafter (simple trial-to-commit path). If you prefer no forward commitment, credits would be charged at standard trial top-up rates.

If you want the credits, I’ll need: (1) confirmation of the preferred option, (2) a short usage CSV (sample attached) so we can size the credit pool precisely, and (3) sign-off on the small SOW amendment (PDF attached). I’ll loop in Rishi and Laura for approval on the commercial side.

—David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_sow_runtime_credit_swap.pdf (SOW sketch); velocity_usage_report_q1.csv (usage template)

From: Priya Menon <priya@velocityai.com>
To: david.kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@velocityai.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — convert remaining POC days to runtime credits?

David — thanks for the clear options. A couple of clarifying Qs from our side before we pick:
- If we take the 20k runtime credits, will that preserve our current priority (dedicated burst) or will it run on best-effort shared capacity? We need deterministic latency for the final benchmarks.
- Can the credits be used for both hosted and dedicated endpoints (we use both)?

If credits guarantee burst priority for the period, we prefer the 20k credits. If not, we’d rather take a 7-day extension. We’ll fill out the CSV and aim to confirm today.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Engineering, Velocity AI

From: david.kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Velocity AI — credit vs extension (quick approval requested)

Folks — forwarding a short ask from Velocity (see below). They prefer credits if we can guarantee the same burst priority they had during the POC. Two quick commercial asks: 1) ability to mark the credits as "priority-burst" for 30 days, 2) whether we can offer the 20k-credit swap at a 15% concession to close quickly.

If approved, I’ll send a short SOW amendment and process the credit top-up. If you have a counter (e.g., smaller credit pool + 3-day extension), shout. Need a sign-off before EOD to keep their momentum.

—David

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Velocity AI — credit vs extension (quick approval requested)

David — OK to proceed with a priority-burst credit swap, but let's cap the concession. Approve the 20k runtime credits but only at a 12% discount (not 15%). Also approve a fallback hybrid: 10k credits + 3-day extension if Velocity pushes back on the priority guarantee. Laura — can your team mark the credit bucket as priority in the billing config and confirm it in the amendment? Monica — please clear we can process without a contract change (SOW amendment only).

If Velocity accepts these terms I’m fine with you issuing the SOW and processing the credit top-up.

-Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
